short_description: Fix SSO login failure after IDP upgrade
description: Users are unable to log in via SSO after the Identity Provider was upgraded to version 5.0. The login page redirects but returns a generic error. Initial investigation shows the token expiration is too short for the new IDP session handling.
acceptance_criteria:
1. Users can log in via SSO successfully.
2. Token TTL is set to 3600 seconds.
3. No regression in direct login.
u_technical_specification: Root cause: The auth middleware (v2.1) uses a hardcoded token TTL of 1800s, which is too short for IDP v5.0's session management. Fix: Update auth middleware to v2.3 with configurable token TTL. Set TTL to 3600s via environment variable AUTH_TOKEN_TTL. Restart the worker pool to apply the change.
